title: hidio
description: `hidio` interfaces with HID devices such as mice, keyboards, joysticks, and gamepads, outputting events in the form `[event_type event_code instance value(` and providing device information through a status outlet. Open a device by index, type, or USB vendor/product IDs, then send a nonzero value to start polling; values greater than 1 also set the polling delay, while 0 stops polling.
